title: Repair the real web pilot overdue-task reasoning failure
problem: Two actual signed-in web turns used V4 and successfully read the same task records, but the follow-up falsely reported zero overdue tasks although the returned outstanding task was already overdue at the turn timestamp.
expected_behavior: Release 3734254e872fcb2f0b5270aac43f8540b40726a2; manifest 1cd49be83211912bae2fce62bf0f0415a486e5f904a48acc65f4c852b2986017. Only sandy-agent-runtime-v4 changes from observed version 29 with an exact prior-source guard. For the existing enrolled pilot, provide server-computed deadline states and counts from the actual task-tool result with fresh as_of evidence, distinguish incomplete coverage, and correct the inherited V2 identity labels. Preserve all other functions, pilot enrollment and gateway/model/auth policy.
change_purpose: Correct the customer-facing failure discovered during the required owner-requested web acceptance test.
feature_improvement: Make task deadline comparisons explicit, bounded and based on current authorized tool records rather than model calendar arithmetic or prior assistant text.
regression_rules: Preserve the current single-pilot allowlist; no new customer tokens, credentials or authorization grants.
Preserve Gmail prepare/confirm/independent-Sent-Mail-verification flow and the separately deployed workspace memory-ingestion hook.
Keep all failed acceptance records and customer data; no task deadline writes or external sends during verification.
Require actual scoped Controller owner approval for these pins, component lease, exact current source/version guard, rollback capture and post-deploy module readback.
acceptance_criteria: Eight new deadline tests cover the actual failure, offsets/DST, missing or invalid deadlines, partial result sets, errors and non-mutation; V4 entrypoint type check passes.
The candidate packages all 27 pinned transitive local modules; only the three listed source modules differ from the prior approved source.
After release verify the actual pilot returns one overdue task from unchanged real records; distinguish trusted API probing from signed-in web acceptance.
Do not mark web or whole SANDY-ENG-0001 accepted until the real follow-up and remaining quality/cross-channel gates pass.
